cells.subject: root-snag
cells.notes: Strong inward root gesture and clean empty central pocket. The upper trunk terminates flat inside the composition; a purposeful continuation crop would need review before final art.

cells.subject: glass-shear
cells.notes: Three unequal broad blades form a clear rising sweep, with restrained dust arc and coherent glass-edge planes. Tiny striations recede at compact size.

cells.subject: bell-repulse
cells.notes: Tilted bell, clapper and large separated pressure crescent clearly indicate a directional burst without concentric target rings.

cells.subject: furnace-draft
cells.notes: The rising heat ribbon and small vent read at compact size. The upper-right ribbon finishes with a flat graphic cut; retain as a force/material concept, not finished VFX.

cells.subject: ash-decoy
cells.notes: Empty folded mantle has a clear hollow hood and trailing dissolution, broad ash planes and restrained fragments; no living body is implied.

cells.subject: rime-tether
cells.notes: Supported stone anchors, taut curved ice strip and distinct cold planes read as a connected bridge/tether at both study sizes.
